title: BOND control file
description: Targets to back up and the settings that govern how each container is built.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editor validation.

targets.description: One container is produced per target that is not skipped.

id.description: Unique name; also the container's file name stem.

skip.description: Leave this target out of a plain 'bond backup' run.

settings.description: Overrides the global settings for this target only.

source.description: A directory tree, plus the filters applied to it. Every filter matches the source-relative path with '/' separators; matching is case-insensitive on Windows.

path.description: Absolute path of the directory (or single file) to back up.

includedPaths.description: Literal source-relative paths to include. Naming a directory includes its whole subtree.

excludedPaths.description: Literal source-relative paths to exclude. Naming a directory excludes its whole subtree.

includedPathPrefixes.description: Include anything whose source-relative path starts with one of these strings.

excludedPathPrefixes.description: Exclude anything whose source-relative path starts with one of these strings.

includedPathPatterns.description: Include anything whose source-relative path matches one of these Go regular expressions.

excludedPathPatterns.description: Exclude anything whose source-relative path matches one of these Go regular expressions.

excludedFileNames.description: Exclude files with these names anywhere in the tree.

excludedDirectoryNames.description: Exclude directories with these names anywhere in the tree, along with everything inside them.

compressionLevel.description: LZMA2 level handed to 7-Zip. 0 stores without compressing and skips 7-Zip entirely.

encryptionMethod.description: The primary key slot. NONE stores the file master key in the container: integrity without confidentiality.

keySlots.description: Additional unlock methods, added alongside the primary one.

recoveryPercent.description: Reed-Solomon parity as a percentage of the payload. 0 disables parity.

shardBytes.description: Size of one shard, which is both the encryption block and the parity unit.

maxVolumeBytes.description: Split the container into volumes of at most this size. 0 writes a single file.

hashAlgorithm.description: Sidecar checksum written next to the container, in sha*sum format.

storeFileIndex.description: Record the file list in the encrypted manifest, so 'bond list' needs no decompression.

followSymlinks.description: Materialize symlink targets as ordinary files/directories. When false, included symlinks are counted, warned about and omitted.

workPath.description: Where containers are assembled before being renamed into outputPath.

type.description: passphrase is prompted for; keyfile reads 32 bytes from a file; recipient encapsulates to a public key.

path.description: Key file location. Required for type 'keyfile'.

publicKey.description: Hybrid X25519 + ML-KEM-1024 public key. Required for type 'recipient'.

label.description: Free-text note shown by 'bond keys list'.
